events.title: Rescue teams search for survivors in Indonesia after powerful earthquake
events.description: Searchers dig through collapsed buildings and debris after 7.7 magnitude quake killed at least 53 people Rescue crews dug through collapsed buildings and landslide debris in eastern Indonesia on Sunday as they searched for bodies and possible survivors a day after a powerful earthquake killed at least 53 people, injured more than 100 and displaced thousands. At least 24 people died in Manggarai regency and 17 in neighbouring East Manggarai, with additional fatalities reported in Sikka, Ngada and Ende regencies, the national disaster management agency said. Rescuers were still searching for people feared buried beneath landslides triggered by the quake across six regencies on Flores, a predominantly Catholic island in Muslim-majority Indonesia. Continue reading...

events.description: Saturday marks the 5th anniversary of the current Taliban rule in Afghanistan. They've had a devastating impact on girls' education. A lesser told story is their impact on the education of boys.

events.title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to enter Spanish North African exclave Ceuta
events.description: The attempted crossings come two weeks after around 72,000 people rushed into the Spanish North African exclave from Morocco. Calls for another mass crossing had been circulating on social media this week.

events.title: Afghan allies still waiting for the safety Germany promised
events.description: After the Taliban retook power on August 15, 2021, Berlin promised to bring Afghan staff to Germany. But people are still waiting to leave in Pakistan and Afghanistan.

events.title: WAFCON final: Women's sport seeks greater recognition
events.description: The Women's Africa Cup of Nations final takes place tonight in Rabat, with Malawi facing Cameroon in a historic showdown. Speaking to FRANCE 24, sports journalist Charlotte Richardson discussed the growing popularity of women's sport, but also the persistent gaps in media coverage, funding and infrastructure compared with men's competitions. She also highlighted the WAFCON's last-minute postponement earlier this year, saying such a decision would be unthinkable in men's football.

events.title: Kushner, Hamas delegation in Egypt for talks on Gaza peace plan
events.description: A Hamas delegation held talks with Egyptian intelligence chief Hassan Rashad in Egypt on Sunday, followed by talks with US envoy Jared Kushner. Kushner had met shortly before with President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi in an effort to break the deadlock over the US-brockered peace plan for Gaza.

events.title: Brazil election: Lula and the new face of Bolsonaro's right
events.description: Brazil's October presidential election is shaping up as another battle between the Lula and Bolsonaro camps, with incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva seeking a fourth term and Flávio Bolsonaro stepping in for his imprisoned father. The two frontrunners are running close in the polls, as Lula focuses on Brazil's sovereignty amid tensions with Washington, while Flávio leans on his family's far-right support and ties to Donald Trump.

events.title: Chad : Opposition figure Succès Masra speaks to France 24
events.description: Chadian opposition leader and former Prime Minister Succès Masra, who founded the opposition party Les Transformateurs and challenged President Mahamat Idriss Déby in the 2024 presidential election, was jailed for more than a year after being sentenced to 20 years in 2025. Pardoned by Déby on August 14, he has now spoken to France 24 about Chad's political situation and his future.

events.title: WAFCON: Malawi and Cameroon face off for historic first crown
events.description: Malawi and Cameroon will face off this Sunday in Rabat at 9pm Paris time in the final of the Women's Africa Cup of Nations. A surprising matchup, with each nation hoping to secure the first continental title in its history.

events.title: Why France's under-15 social media ban was blocked
events.description: France's attempt to ban social media for under-15s has been blocked by the Constitutional Council, which ruled the measure unconstitutional. Speaking to FRANCE 24, Peter Craddock, Senior Attorney advising social media companies, said the decision was unsurprising, arguing that the proposed law imposed a blanket ban without taking into account differences between platforms or children's levels of maturity. The court found that the measure infringed on the fundamental freedom of expression and information.

events.title: Cristiano Ronaldo says it is 'probably' his last season
events.description: Cristiano Ronaldo has said the new football season is "probably" his last.

events.title: More than 100 arrested in Morocco after call for another migrant mass crossing to Ceuta
events.description: At least 111 people have been arrested for trying to get into Ceuta following another call on social media for a mass crossing of migrants.

events.title: The grass beneath our feet: Why rangelands matter
events.description: In northern Kenya, a herder scans the sky for rain that hasn't come. The grass his animals need is thinning by the day.

events.title: Former rebel fighters join campaign against Ebola in the DR Congo
events.description: Demobilised former combatants are actively joining the fight against Ebola by participating in public information campaigns in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

events.title: Youth advocates gather in New York to launch new AI standards
events.description: As artificial intelligence (AI) rapidly transforms everything from how we learn, to the job market, children are adopting the technology more than three times faster than adults – exposing them to unique opportunities and risks.

events.title: Florida man on probation allegedly kills and dismembers stepfather, stuffs body parts in suitcases
events.description: Security footage and three suitcases led Orlando investigators to charge Jose Proano with the murder and dismemberment of his 71-year-old stepfather.

events.title: Serial killer survivor who escaped 18-hour captivity reveals instinct she wishes she never ignored
events.description: Kara Robinson Chamberlain ignored a split-second intuition before Richard Evonitz abducted her at 15. Now she hosts "Somebody Knows Something."

events.title: Routine California traffic stop leads to seizure of 30 pounds of cocaine worth more than $800K
events.description: A California Highway Patrol canine officer stopped a Honda CR-V in Merced County and allegedly found 30 pounds of suspected cocaine worth $817,200.

events.title: Ex-detective who served fraction of 102-year sentence faces new charges after cold case review
events.description: Former Los Angeles vice detective Michael Douglas Brambles, paroled in 2020 under California's elderly inmates law, faces new kidnapping charges.

events.title: Florida middle school teacher admits to years of 'inappropriate' conversations with former student: deputies
events.description: Christian Schneider, a Memorial Middle School teacher, allegedly sent inappropriate messages to a former teenage student since 2023, authorities say.

events.title: Florida cold case suspect allegedly confesses to 1987 murder and reveals secret crime scene details
events.description: A Florida man allegedly called police to confess to a 1987 Jacksonville murder, describing crime scene details that had never been publicly released.

events.title: Shake Shack worker allegedly calls out before robbing own restaurant, returns in uniform 2 days later
events.description: An Arizona Shake Shack employee allegedly robbed his own restaurant at gunpoint, locked co-workers in a cooler, then returned in uniform two days later.

events.title: California teen faces prison after viral video shows him squaring up, repeatedly kicking sea lion in the face
events.description: Tyler Muehl admitted to kicking a sea lion in La Jolla while referring to himself as UFC fighter Max Holloway. He faces up to a year in prison.

events.description: Gregory Henderson Jr. was captured three days after being added to the FBI Ten Most Wanted list for alleged drug trafficking tied to the Sinaloa Cartel.

events.description: Spain's African enclave Ceuta sees soldiers patrolling streets, and Morocco says it arrested those inciting a second mass border crossing on Saturday.

events.description: Construction workers in Belgium discovered $10 million in gold coins and bars while building a sewer, but a finder's fee remains uncertain.

events.description: The Mecca Joint Defence Agreement signed by Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan raises questions about whether it signals a Middle East shift from the U.S.

events.description: UNESCO says 2.4 million Afghan girls are locked out of secondary school five years after the Taliban banned female education beyond the primary level.
